name: TableQuery
docs:
Table specified through a sub-query
Example:
```sql
INSERT INTO
(SELECT employee_id, last_name, email, hire_date, job_id,  salary, commission_pct FROM employees)
VALUES (207, 'Gregory', 'pgregory@example.com', sysdate, 'PU_CLERK', 1.2E3, NULL);
```
